init_distributed_mode: initialize distributed training mode for SLURM multi-node multi-GPU jobs using params object
init_signal_handler: install SLURM signal handlers for SIGUSR1 preemption and SIGTERM bypass in cluster jobs
sig_handler: handle SIGUSR1 signal to requeue SLURM job on time limit or preemption events
term_handler: handle SIGTERM signal by logging and bypassing termination in SLURM cluster jobs
review_slurm_module: review the slurm module functions for distributed training initialization and signal handling
